key_insight: Cold spray enables solid-state repair and additive manufacturing of metals and composites with low oxidation, low thermal distortion, and high microstructural integrity.
engineering_relevance: The review positions cold spray as a practical route for restoring critical components and building complex, high-performance parts where mechanical reliability matters.
method: Review of recent cold spray repair and deposition developments
Survey of cold spray additive manufacturing strategies and hybrid/gradient structures
Discussion of industrial qualification needs, predictive modeling, and in situ monitoring
evidence_signal: The paper synthesizes published advances across coating/deposit quality, material systems, and CSAM applications, but it does not present new experimental data in the abstract.
watch_item: Industrial adoption still depends on standardized qualification, reliable in situ monitoring, and predictive models to control deposition quality and part performance.
paper_title: Advances in Cold Spray for Repair and Additive Manufacturing: A Review
